import subprocess,json,re
base='/opt/telegram-robot-leads/'
python=base+'.venv/bin/python'
sha=open(base+'.verified-source-commit').read().strip()
jobs=[
('operational',[python,base+'scripts/leads_operational_report.py','--vault','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads','--checkout',base,'--expected-source',sha,'--with-pm2']),
('health',[python,base+'scripts/lead_health.py','--root','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads','--with-pm2'])
]
def cleanse(obj,key=''):
 if isinstance(obj,dict):
  out={}
  for k,v in obj.items():
   if re.search(r'(?i)(secret|token|hash|password|api_id|username|account_id|user_id|phone|invite_url|group_handle|target_group|session_key|auth_key)',k):continue
   out[k]=cleanse(v,k)
  return out
 if isinstance(obj,list):return [cleanse(x,key) for x in obj[:12]]
 if isinstance(obj,str):
  if len(obj)>350:return obj[:350]+'...'
  obj=re.sub(r'@[A-Za-z0-9_]+','@REDACTED',obj)
  obj=re.sub(r'\b\d{9,15}\b','[ID]',obj)
  return obj
 return obj
for name,cmd in jobs:
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=25)
 print('REPORT',name,'EXIT',p.returncode,'STDERR',cleanse(p.stderr[-300:]))
 try:
  o=json.loads(p.stdout)
  print('REPORT_JSON',name,json.dumps(cleanse(o),ensure_ascii=True)[:10500])
 except Exception as e:print('REPORT_JSON_ERROR',name,type(e).__name__,'OUT',cleanse(p.stdout[:1200]))
print('OPERATIONAL_REPORT_END')
PY
